# Session Nine

## Hydra

Ask the players the following questions:

- How do you track down the Hydra's current locations?
- How do you acquire weapons of your namesake?
- How do you intend to trap and vanquish the Hydra?

The Hydra is the mountain ruins of Lugran, a castle once used for mining.

> Metal clinks off the crumbling stones.
> The white and green lights of the sky fizzles as windbound sands scrape against the ruins.
> You find the mine tower.
> It was at the deepest point of the once grand castle yet you are at its top.


> Descending down the circular stair you're careful not to fall into the centre.
> You could brave the rope that was once used to lift up treasures but you fear it'll next be used for your coffin.
> So steadily you descend into the abyss.

Break her to go to Desert Hag section

> Finally you reach the bottom and exit the tower.
> The scene is lit by glittering green and yellow light bouncing off the ores and gems of the uneven walls.
> Tracks zigzag over the floors leading to various tunnels, carts standing and fallen full of precious minerals.
> The smell of wet copper, iron and sulpher clings to the air.
> There is so much to see, dead smelter, wooden cranes, wooden cabins with pots of dessicated food, and the bones of miners.
> But their is one feature all your eyes attempt to focus on.
> One of the cart tracks leads into a perfectly circular and perfectly vertical tunnel.
> No light penetrates it and light leaves it.
> The Hydra's hollow.

> The warm embrace of Emerald.
> You open your eyes to see your allies enveloped in the emerald too.
> You hear a voice in your head.
> Once you did not recognise it but through eternal repetitions you know it be your own.
> And so you recite the oath again.

> Seek the Purple<br>
> Honour the Emerald<br>
> Protect the Harvest<br>

> Once more for luck

> Seek the Purple<br>
> Honour the Emerald<br>
> Protect the Harvest<br>

> A jostle followed by a gentle thud.
> A blur of images but once you fully gain your senses you feel the ground below your feet and see the green lights above.
> The tower has dropped you by the lake.
> You all now remember the mission The Green Eyed Seer has gifted you.
> Find the Desert hag and eliminate her, she has taken the rain.
> It will reduce the harvest.
> Shocked by the lack of rain but even without the sight of a dried out lake you would know it to be true.
> The Green Eyed Seer is all seeing.

Challenges

- Traversing the desert
    - A giant buzzard hunts the company
    - Sand storms and mirages trick their senses into losing direction (CLA)
    - The cold nights sap their energy (VIG)
    - The heat and sun thirsts for their spirit (SPI)
    - Floating eyeballs of sand roam the desert trying to spot any interlopers
- The hag's den
    - A  deep massive crater
    - A surface of hard purple dust where all feels weightless
    - At the bottom are structures
    - Perimeter of raised black glass all facing the sun (solar panels)
    - Within are white cylindrical buildings topped with domes
        - Cylinders made of distinct panels whilst domes constructed from triangles
    - Middle is a Large tower, thick at the bottom and pointed at the top
        - At the top the Dust hag watches
        - 5 defense drones
    - In essence like the moon

Dust hag
    - Large white puffy suit with a golden glass visor
    - The end of her white gauntlets end in thick tubes where purple dust slowly drifts from
    - She moves in what looks like slow motion but is incredibly controlled
    - Wants Entertainment of a very specific type (wishes to see knights fight and kill each other)
    - She hates the seers so enjoys their pawns (knights) killing one another
